Mod.Name: 少女当铺 / Maiden’s Pawnshop
Mod.Author: 远风肆业
Mod.Description:
动漫像素风角色立绘替换：209 张立绘，覆盖 221 个立绘资源键，包括 18 个具有异常瞳孔及皮肤条码编号的改造体（伪人）。本 MOD 替换角色立绘、通缉名单头像、发明家商店及地图预览中的人物和场景安保立绘。通缉名单保留原版配色、姓名、悬赏金额和划除标记。游戏内改造体鉴别指南同步展示异常瞳孔、皮肤条码与编号，保留原版行为线索。
采用轻量化美术替换，仅调整外观，不改变玩法或存档。与修改相同美术资源或相关显示功能的 MOD 可能存在覆盖或兼容性冲突。对话框下移由独立组件提供。
美术由 AI 协助制作。
Anime pixel-art character portrait replacements: 209 artworks covering 221 portrait keys, including 18 augmented impostors with abnormal pupils and skin barcode identifiers. This mod replaces character portraits, wanted-list mugshots, the inventor in his shop and map preview, and security portraits placed in the scene. The wanted list retains its original palette, names, bounties, and crossed-out markers. The in-game augmented identification guide shows abnormal pupils, skin barcodes and serial numbers while retaining the original behavioral clues.
A lightweight visual replacement that does not change gameplay or save data. Mods changing the same artwork or related display features may override one another or have compatibility conflicts. Dialogue repositioning is provided by a separate addon.
AI-assisted artwork.
